conditional_findings.classification: New95e source-level documentation versus capability-selection discrepancy, connected to Segovb572; the intended gameplay/content policy remains to be decided.
conditional_findings.canonical_owner: AnimationPackLibrary::attack_animations contract and authored main/offhand capability inheritance.
conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: The function documentation says that a pack owning any attack owns the complete attack choice, but the implementation selects main-hand attacks and offhand capability independently across the fallback chain.
conditional_findings.trace: attack_animations chooses the nearest pack with swing or thrust as its main set, while OR-ing an available offhand attack from each visited pack until both main and offhand are present. Current source test child_attack_set_is_all_or_nothing_and_empty_child_inherits describes a child containing AttackSwing over a parent containing AttackOffhand and expects child swing with inherited offhand. Runtime source builds its library from loaded clip anchors and semantic routing reads attack_animations for the equipped pack.
conditional_findings.safeguards: This establishes a source documentation/code and source-assertion mismatch, not a run test, observed missing clip, actual authored partial-load condition or proof that split inheritance is wrong. Incomplete-art packs and deliberate content inheritance are supported modes, not automatically compatibility shims. Earlier Segovb572 identified this policy/comment ambiguity without accepting a finding.
dependencies: Confirm the desired main-hand/offhand inheritance policy and inspect actual loaded-content and gameplay/presentation consumers.
Align the owning contract and implementation around the chosen policy; preserve optional incomplete-art and legitimate independent capability modes where intended.
Reconcile original059 queue1450 and exact aliases without changing earlier reviewer attribution.
later_acceptance: The documented capability selection and source behavior agree for a child with only a main attack, only an offhand attack, and no attacks.
Preserve supported attack and content-loading behavior; any later tests or runtime checks require separate authorization.

conditional_findings.classification: New95e conditional representability question for a configured reference acceleration and presentation angle; no live failure observed.
conditional_findings.canonical_owner: BodyResponseConfig reference-acceleration admission and the consuming body-angle scaling operation, with physical acceleration remaining a separately measured quantity.
conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: A finite positive acceleration divisor alone does not guarantee a finite component/reference ratio before the consumer constructs and caps a body angle.
conditional_findings.trace: ReferenceAcceleration rejects zero/nonfinite/negative but permits arbitrarily small positive finite f32 values. ProceduralAnimationConfig validates the presentation gap and response cap but has no shown additional bound on the two reference acceleration fields. Inertial lean divides smoothed body-local acceleration by the configured forward/lateral reference; BodyAngle::from_authored_scale checks the multiplied angle before subsequent clamping. The copied presentation body-response state is rejected and not published when the operation errors.
conditional_findings.symbolic_example: A positive reference 2^-140 and a finite nonzero component 0.5 give the exact quotient 2^139, above the largest finite binary32 value (<2^128). Both operands are representable binary32 values. The committed YAML uses forward12.0 and lateral10.0 with nonzero forward lean10 degrees. This is exact source-directed arithmetic, not a parsed configuration, motion sample, animation or product run.
conditional_findings.safeguards: A normal result requires a continuous, grounded, unguarded, no-action presentation path and a nonzero filtered acceleration; the source resets response in several other modes. The current authority projection clamps acceleration magnitude to80 after checking it. No full extreme configuration was parsed or installed, no matching smoothed sample or rejected frame observed, and support for such tuning is undecided. A positive-but-tiny landing recovery issue in ASSESSMENT-LANDING-SETTLE-95E.json has a different owner and operation; no exact alias is assumed.
dependencies: Trace supported configuration admission, acceleration producers and smoothing, native angle conversion, all call sites and field policy.
Define a representable/meaningful input relationship or an explicit bounded computation before publication while preserving normal authored response.
Reconcile original059 queue1452 and prior quantity-context question without treating BodyAngle reattribution alone as a string or correctness defect.
later_acceptance: Every supported reference and measured component reaches a defined finite body-angle result or is rejected with owning context before presentation.
Preserve legitimate zero acceleration, normal positive authored tuning and presentation-only behavior; later validation is separately authorized.
